text_en: Samuel said to Saul, “The Lord sent me to anoint you king over his people Israel; now therefore listen to the words of the Lord .
text_cn: 有一天，撒慕尔对撒乌耳说：“上主曾打发我给你傅油，作他人民以色列的君王，如今你应听上主的话！

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts, ‘I will punish the Amalekites for what they did in opposing the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：我要惩罚阿玛肋克对以色列所行的事，因为当以色列从埃及上来时，拦截了去路。

text_en: Now go and attack Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have; do not spare them, but kill both man and woman, child and infant, ox and sheep, camel and donkey. ’”
text_cn: 如今你去攻打阿玛肋克，毁灭他们和他们所有的一切，丝毫不可顾惜，要将男女、孩童、婴儿、牛羊﹑骆驼和驴，一律杀掉。”

text_en: So Saul summoned the people, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand foot soldiers, and ten thousand soldiers of Judah.
text_cn: 撒乌耳调集了军人，在特冷检阅了他们，计步兵二十万，犹大人一万。

text_en: Saul came to the city of the Amalekites and lay in wait in the valley.
text_cn: 撒乌耳来到阿玛肋克城时，在山谷里设下了埋伏。

text_en: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go! Leave! Withdraw from among the Amalekites, or I will destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the people of Israel when they came up out of Egypt. ” So the Kenites withdrew from the Amalekites.
text_cn: 撒乌耳对刻尼人说：“你们起来快走，离开阿玛肋克人，免得我把你们同他们一起消灭，因为以色列子民由埃及上来时，你们善待了他们。”刻尼人便离开阿玛肋克人走了。

text_en: Saul defeated the Amalekites, from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt.
text_cn: 撒乌耳击杀阿玛肋克人，从哈威拉一直杀到埃及东面的叔尔，

text_en: He took King Agag of the Amalekites alive, but utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
text_cn: 活捉了阿玛肋克王阿加格，用刀杀尽了其余的人民。

text_en: Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep and of the cattle and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was valuable, and would not utterly destroy them; all that was despised and worthless they utterly destroyed.
text_cn: 但撒乌耳和军民却怜惜阿加格和最好的牛羊，肥美的家畜和羔羊；凡是美好的，他们都不愿毁灭，只把一切不值钱，不要的牲畜毁灭了。

text_en: The word of the Lord came to Samuel:
text_cn: 那时有上主的话传于撒慕尔说：

text_en: “I regret that I made Saul king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not carried out my commands. ” Samuel was angry; and he cried out to the Lord all night.
text_cn: “我后悔立了撒乌耳为王，因为他背离了我，没有遵从我的命令。”撒慕尔感到不安，整夜哀求上主。

text_en: Samuel rose early in the morning to meet Saul, and Samuel was told, “Saul went to Carmel, where he set up a monument for himself, and on returning he passed on down to Gilgal. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔清晨起来去见撒乌耳；有人告诉他说：“撒乌耳去了加尔默耳，在那里立了纪念碑，然后回来经过这里，又去了基耳加耳。”

text_en: When Samuel came to Saul, Saul said to him, “May you be blessed by the Lord ; I have carried out the command of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔来到撒乌耳那里，撒乌耳就对他说：“愿天主祝福你！我履行了上主的命令。”

text_en: But Samuel said, “What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears, and the lowing of cattle that I hear? ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔就问说：“怎么我耳中听见有羊叫，有牛鸣？”

text_en: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and the cattle, to sacrifice to the Lord your God; but the rest we have utterly destroyed. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答说：“那是从阿玛肋克带回来的，因为人民爱惜那些最好的牛羊，好献给上主你的天主；至于其余的，我们都毁灭了。”

text_en: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stop! I will tell you what the Lord said to me last night. ” He replied, “Speak. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔对撒乌耳说：“住口！让我告诉你，上主昨夜对我说过的话。”撒乌耳答说：“请说吧！”

text_en: Samuel said, “Though you are little in your own eyes, are you not the head of the tribes of Israel? The Lord anointed you king over Israel.
text_cn: 撒慕尔说：“虽然你自以为是最微小的，你岂不是已成了以色列众支派的首领？上主不是曾给你傅油，立你作以色列的君王吗？

text_en: And the Lord sent you on a mission, and said, ‘Go, utterly destroy the sinners, the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed. ’
text_cn: 上主派你去打仗，曾吩咐你说：去剿灭那些犯罪的阿玛肋克人，攻打他们，直至将他们完全消灭。

text_en: Why then did you not obey the voice of the Lord ? Why did you swoop down on the spoil, and do what was evil in the sight of the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 为什么你没有顺听上主的命令，只顾急忙抢掠财物，行了上主不喜欢的事？”

text_en: Saul said to Samuel, “I have obeyed the voice of the Lord , I have gone on the mission on which the Lord sent me, I have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and I have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
text_cn: 撒乌耳回答撒慕尔说：“我的确听从了上主的命令，走了上主指给我的路，擒获了阿玛肋克王阿加格，毁灭了阿玛肋克人。

text_en: But from the spoil the people took sheep and cattle, the best of the things devoted to destruction, to sacrifice to the Lord your God in Gilgal. ”
text_cn: 但是军民由当毁灭的胜利品中，选出了最好的牛羊，要在基耳加耳祭献上主，你的天主。”

text_en: And Samuel said, “Has the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obedience to the voice of the Lord ? Surely, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed than the fat of rams.
text_cn: 撒慕尔回答说：“上主岂能喜欢全燔祭和牺牲，胜过听从上主的命令？ 听命胜于祭献，服从胜过绵羊的肥油脂。

text_en: For rebellion is no less a sin than divination, and stubbornness is like iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the Lord , he has also rejected you from being king. ”
text_cn: 背命等于行卜，顽抗与敬拜偶像无异。因为你拒绝了上主的命令，上主也拒绝了你作王。”

text_en: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
text_cn: 撒乌耳对撒慕尔说：“我犯了罪，违背了上主的命令和你的话，因我害怕人民，才听从了他们的呼声。

text_en: Now therefore, I pray, pardon my sin, and return with me, so that I may worship the Lord . ”
text_cn: 现在，请你宽赦我的罪过，同我一起回去，让我朝拜上主。”

text_en: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected the word of the Lord , and the Lord has rejected you from being king over Israel. ”
text_cn: 撒慕尔却对撒乌耳说：“我不同你回去；既然你拒绝了上主的命令，上主也拒绝你，不要你作以色列王。”

text_en: As Samuel turned to go away, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.
text_cn: 撒慕尔转身就走，撒乌耳用力抓住他外氅的衣边，撕下了一块。

text_en: And Samuel said to him, “The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you this very day, and has given it to a neighbor of yours, who is better than you.
text_cn: 撒慕尔于是对他说：“上主今日从你身上撕下了你的王位，给了一个比你更好的人。

text_en: Moreover the Glory of Israel will not recant or change his mind; for he is not a mortal, that he should change his mind. ”
text_cn: 并且以色列的光荣绝不发虚言，也不会懊悔，因为他不像人，可以懊悔。”

text_en: Then Saul said, “I have sinned; yet honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, so that I may worship the Lord your God. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳遂说：“我固然犯了罪，但如今请你在我民族的长老和以色列前，仍尊重我，同我一起回去，好让我朝拜上主，你的天主。”

text_en: So Samuel turned back after Saul; and Saul worshiped the Lord .
text_cn: 撒慕尔便随同撒乌耳一起回去，撒乌耳朝拜了上主。

text_en: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag king of the Amalekites here to me. ” And Agag came to him haltingly. Agag said, “Surely this is the bitterness of death. ”
text_cn: 以后撒慕尔说：“将阿玛肋克王阿加格给我解来！”阿加格到了他那里，很是高兴，阿加格心想：“死亡的苦的确过去了。”

text_en: But Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother shall be childless among women. ” And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.
text_cn: 撒慕尔对他说：“你的剑怎样使众多妇女丧子，你的母亲在妇女中也要怎样丧子。”撒慕尔就在基耳加耳上主面前杀了阿加格。

text_en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah of Saul.
text_cn: 以后撒慕尔去了辣玛，撒乌耳也回了撒乌耳的基贝亚本家。

text_en: Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his death, but Samuel grieved over Saul. And the Lord was sorry that he had made Saul king over Israel.
text_cn: 撒慕尔至死再没有见撒乌耳。撒慕尔为了撒乌耳很是伤心，因为，上主后悔立了撒乌耳作以色列的君王。
